local_branch: Train-only class-balanced ridge multinomial residual head
reuse_policy: Reuse PAT-B-260727-004 train-LOCO scores, 8-anchor validation scores, and PAT-B-260727-003 validation-only Tip-F logits.

residual_head.standardization: Fold-train feature mean and population standard deviation with floor 0.02
residual_head.model: 4x4 linear multinomial logits plus intercept, centered across output classes per image
residual_head.loss: Class-balanced cross entropy plus 0.5*lambda*sum(W^2); intercept is not regularized
residual_head.optimizer: Deterministic float64 LBFGS with zero initialization and strong-Wolfe line search
residual_head.train_cv: Four-fold deterministic stratification by style; every image is a distinct church
residual_head.selection_metric: Mean fold balanced accuracy minus 0.25 sample SD
residual_head.random_control_policy: Fit one head per random bank using the official-head selected lambda and the same train labels.

candidate_safety.policy: Unsafe candidates are ineligible before robust-score ranking.

selection.metric: Among style-safe candidates, mean paired validation accuracy delta minus 0.5 sample SD
selection.tie_break: Higher official-minus-random delta, then smaller gamma, then lower gate threshold
selection.test_loader_policy: No test loader, features, dense tokens, or logits may be constructed during selection.
